description: Comprehensive test scenario simulating a complex multi-day Indian wedding with various vendors, payments, tasks, and sub-events

prompts.prompt: I'm planning Priya and Rahul's wedding for August 15th, 2026
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates event with name and date

prompts.prompt: We have 5 events: Mehndi on Aug 12th at 4pm, Sangeet on Aug 13th evening, Haldi ceremony Aug 14th morning, Wedding ceremony Aug 15th at 11am, and Reception Aug 15th at 7pm
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates 5 sub-events with dates and times

prompts.prompt: Booked The Grand Pavilion as our venue for $45,000. Paid $15,000 deposit today, remaining due July 1st
prompts.expected_behavior: Should ask for vendor category OR infer venue, create payment + pending payment + task

prompts.prompt: Paid Enmuse Photography $12,000 in full today via bank transfer for all events coverage
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates vendor and single payment, no pending

prompts.prompt: I paid my caterer $8,000 yesterday as a deposit
prompts.expected_behavior: Should ask for the caterer's business name

follow_up.expected_behavior: Creates vendor with category=catering and payment

prompts.prompt: Booked Henna by Priya for mehndi, total cost $2,500. Gave her $500 advance, rest due day before the event
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates mehndi vendor, payment, pending payment for Aug 11

prompts.prompt: Add these tasks: 1) Finalize guest list by April 15th 2) Order wedding invitations by May 1st 3) Book hotel rooms for guests by June 1st 4) Arrange airport pickups for out-of-town family
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates 4 tasks with appropriate due dates

prompts.prompt: Hired Celebrations Decor for $18,000. Paid $6,000 today, $6,000 due June 15th, final $6,000 due Aug 10th
prompts.expected_behavior: Should ask vendor type, then create payment with 2 pending payments

follow_up.prompt: They're our decorator for all events

prompts.prompt: DJ Krish will handle sangeet music for $3,500. Paid $1,000 booking fee via Venmo
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates DJ vendor with partial payment

prompts.prompt: Pandit Sharma will perform the wedding ceremony. His fee is $1,500, paid in full today by check
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates officiant vendor with full payment

prompts.prompt: Glow by Neha will do bridal makeup and hair. Total $4,000, paid $1,500 deposit
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates makeup_hair vendor

prompts.prompt: Petals & Blooms will handle all floral arrangements for $7,500. Paid today in full
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates florist vendor with full payment

prompts.prompt: Video Vihaar will do cinematic wedding film for $8,000. Paid half today
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates videography vendor

prompts.prompt: Hired Dance With Me studio to choreograph sangeet performances. $2,000 total, paid $800 for first session
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates choreographer vendor

prompts.prompt: Ordered wedding invitations from Paper Trail for $1,800. Paid in full yesterday
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates invitations vendor

prompts.prompt: Bought Priya's bridal lehenga from Sabyasachi for $15,000. Paid $10,000, rest due on pickup in July
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates attire vendor

prompts.prompt: Purchased bridal jewelry set from Tanishq for $8,500 cash
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates jewelry vendor with full payment

prompts.prompt: Booked Punjab Dhol Group for baraat procession - $800, paid today
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates music_dj vendor

prompts.prompt: Rented vintage car from Classic Rides for $1,200 for the wedding day. Paid $400 deposit
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates transportation vendor

prompts.prompt: Sweet Delights will make 3-tier wedding cake for $600. Paid in full
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates bakery vendor

prompts.prompt: How much have I spent so far?
prompts.expected_behavior: Returns aggregate of all payments made

prompts.prompt: What payments are still pending?
prompts.expected_behavior: Lists all pending payments with amounts and due dates

prompts.prompt: How much have I paid the decorator?
prompts.expected_behavior: Returns payment info for Celebrations Decor

prompts.prompt: Just paid another $2,000 to DJ Krish today
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates additional payment to existing vendor, updates remaining balance logic

prompts.prompt: Need to move the sangeet to Aug 13th at 6pm instead
prompts.expected_behavior: Updates sangeet sub-event time

prompts.prompt: Schedule a venue walkthrough on May 20th at 2pm at The Grand Pavilion
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates calendar event

prompts.prompt: Mark the guest list task as complete
prompts.expected_behavior: Updates task status to completed

prompts.prompt: What tasks are still pending?
prompts.expected_behavior: Lists incomplete tasks

prompts.prompt: Show me all my booked vendors
prompts.expected_behavior: Lists all vendors with categories

prompts.prompt: Paid Rani Events $5,000 deposit today
prompts.expected_behavior: Should ask what type of vendor Rani Events is

prompts.prompt: Paid Enmuse Photography $12,000 today
prompts.expected_behavior: Should detect potential duplicate and ask for clarification

prompts.prompt: Need to pay the videographer remaining balance next Friday
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates task with correct relative date calculation

prompts.prompt: What's my largest expense so far?
prompts.expected_behavior: Returns the highest payment (venue $15,000 or lehenga $10,000)

prompts.prompt: What payments are due in the next 30 days?
prompts.expected_behavior: Filters and returns upcoming pending payments

prompts.prompt: Remove the airport pickup task, we don't need it anymore
prompts.expected_behavior: Should confirm before deleting

prompts.prompt: Hired Dream Day Planners as our wedding coordinator for $8,000. Paid $3,000 retainer
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates planner vendor

prompts.prompt: Ordered 200 wedding favors from Gift Gallery for $1,500. Paid in full
prompts.expected_behavior: Creates favors vendor

prompts.prompt: Give me a summary of the wedding budget
prompts.expected_behavior: Provides comprehensive budget overview

prompts.prompt: And how much is still owed?
prompts.expected_behavior: Uses conversation context to understand this refers to budget/payments

prompts.prompt: List all vendors and their payment status
prompts.expected_behavior: Comprehensive vendor list with paid/pending amounts
